events.statement: order-service error_rate deviated from a flat ~0.2% baseline to ~18% at the 12:12:00Z bucket. 4-minute buckets show 0.20% at 12:08:00Z then 18.66% at 12:12:00Z; the 2-minute zoom shows 0.17% at 12:10:00Z and 17.95% at 12:12:00Z, and the first ERROR log is at 12:12:31Z. Onset window: 12:10Z-12:12Z.

The 500s are dominated by a NullPointerException in MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) with orderType=FNO (derivatives/futures & options): top_patterns show 224 occurrences of the MarginCheckValidator NPE at line 88 and 202 of 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account'. Every sampled error line carrying an orderType is FNO.

Failures are immediate (NPE thrown synchronously in the validator, no timeout/upstream-call frame anywhere in the error lines) and only the derivatives (FNO) order path through MarginCheckValidator is affected; the errors are a hard 500 rejection, not a latency-driven failure.

Fraction of traffic failing is ~18% of all order-service requests: error_rate sits at 17.6-19.1% (mean ~18%) throughout 12:12Z-13:59Z while request_rate stays flat at ~232 req/s (205-256 req/s), i.e. total order volume is unchanged and a stable ~18% slice fails.

order-service resources show no degradation concurrent with onset: CPU pegged at ~40% (39.4-40.9 avg) unchanged, memory ~60% flat, and db_pool_in_use flat at ~14 connections (13.78-14.33) across the whole 11:00Z-13:59Z window including the 12:12Z onset.

Sub-second/4-minute error_rate buckets are available (180 points, no missing), so the ~18% level is a sustained plateau, not a transient spike: it holds from 12:12Z through the last bucket 13:56Z (18.69%) with no recovery.

events.summary: H1 is well grounded: the causal chain rests on verified findings at every hop, the cause precedes onset tightly, and alternatives are contradicted rather than merely dismissed. (1) Grounding — F7/F13/F18 dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0, 12:10:00Z) is VERIFIED, with change set literally "new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain" + "remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()", and F2's verified error text is a NPE at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 with "marginProfile is null", orderType=FNO. The failing symbol and the deploy's new symbol are the same; no leap of faith. F14 confirms zero order-service config changes, so a flag is not a hidden cause. (2) Temporal order — onset window 12:10-12:12Z (F1), first ERROR 12:12:31Z; deploy at 12:10:00Z precedes onset by ~2 min, tight and one-directional. (3) Scope — F4 shows a stable ~18% slice of unchanged ~232 req/s traffic failing; F3 shows every orderType-bearing error is FNO; blast radius is fully explained by the FNO-only path through the new validator. (4) Alternatives — H2 (pricing-engine): F18 shows zero pricing-engine deploys/config changes in 11:00Z-14:00Z, and F3 shows an immediate synchronous NPE with no upstream-call/timeout frame and no latency signature, which a downstream margin-data degradation (or an unhandled null from a malformed response) would not produce; contradictions are evidence-based, not opinion. H3 (resource/pool): F5 flat CPU ~40%, memory ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14, and F4 flat traffic with no retry surge. H4 (TLS/DNS/network): F2 shows only application-level NPEs; F12/F16 show no matching precedent. All recent changes across all services were inventoried (F7, F8, F9), so the alternative space really is empty. (5) Data quality — the only partial result is the truncated 40/426 log sample; it is not used to infer absence, only to confirm the dominant signature, which is corroborated by metrics. (6) Calibration — 0.86 is very slightly above what a missing rollback confirmation supports, so I cap at 0.85. The remaining gaps (rollback recovery, pricing-engine's own telemetry) are confirmatory of an already-established origin, not differentiator evidence; per the round-cost rule they don't justify another round during a SEV-1.
